title: Are we there yet with XNA aptamers?
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22227-22246

Santiago Chaillou, Saphyra Thonon, Sten Reynders, Eveline Lescrinier, Vitor B. Pinheiro
Since their original development, aptamers have been heralded as possible and promising new therapeutic modalities. Here, we explore the state of the art of (XNA) aptamers, and the bottlenecks the field is currently tackling.
